title: Using a fidget tool kindly
group: LDS-FOCUS — Focus and Getting Things Done
examples: Can a fidget help me listen?
How do I use a fidget at school?

explain.say: Some hands love to be busy. A fidget tool, like a squeeze ball, gives your hands a job so your ears can listen. Look at the board. We are sorting ways to use a fidget.
See the first group glow? Kind and quiet. Squeeze it in your hand. Keep it low. Twist it with no sound. Keep your eyes on the teacher. Can you squeeze your hand gently now?

Now look at the other group. Pulls attention. Throwing it, loud clicking, or playing a game with it. Then the fidget is a toy, not a tool. It pulls your eyes, and other people's eyes too. Can you see the difference?
Here is a simple test. Ask yourself, Can I still hear the teacher? Is anyone else distracted? If you can hear and nobody is bothered, you are using it kindly.
If it starts to pull attention, put it in your pocket for a minute. That is a smart choice. Great thinking! Here is a challenge. Tell a grown-up your two fidget rules: quiet, and hands low.

faq.a: At school, a fidget is a tool. It keeps your hands busy so your brain can listen. When you play games with it, it becomes a toy.
asks: Tell me about Kind and quiet

faq.q: How does a fidget help me listen?
faq.a: Some people focus better when their hands are moving. The fidget gives the movement a quiet place to go.
It means your eyes, or other people's eyes, move to the fidget instead of the lesson. Throwing and clicking do that.

faq.q: Can I bring a fidget to school?
faq.a: Ask your teacher first. You can say, Would a fidget help me listen? A grown-up you trust can help you choose a quiet one.

faq.q: What other quiet fidgets are there?
faq.a: A smooth stone, a stretchy band, a bit of soft fabric, or putty. Quiet ones work best.

facts: A fidget tool is used to keep hands busy, while the eyes and ears stay on the lesson.
Quiet fidgets, like putty or a squeeze ball, are less distracting for others.

quiz.say: Which is a kind way to use a fidget?
quiz.show: Which is a kind way to fidget?

options.show: Squeeze it quietly in my hand
options.say: Squeeze it quietly in my hand

quiz.why: Quiet squeezing keeps your hands busy and lets everyone listen.

wrong.1: Throwing turns it into a game and pulls attention.
wrong.2: Loud clicks pull other people's attention.

quiz.say: Your fidget starts to distract you. What can you do?
quiz.show: Your fidget distracts you. What now?

options.show: Put it in my pocket for a bit
options.say: Put it in my pocket for a bit

options.show: Give it to a friend to throw
options.say: Give it to a friend to throw

quiz.why: A short pocket break helps you get back to listening.

wrong.1: Playing more pulls your attention further away.
